title: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center
authors: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center
content: 台架轴承正常与人工单点故障振动数据。

reference_value: 练习读MAT、时域/频谱、简单分类；保留原始文件标识。

title: Paderborn University Bearing DataCenter
authors: Paderborn University, Chair of Design and Drive Technology (KAt)

reference_value: 按轴承编号/工况分组；练习跨设备和跨工况评价。
